$comment: Who reads Tenon. One route for all of them: a git dependency pinned to a tag. sync reports which tag each is on and writes nothing — bumping a consumer means editing its own package.json and reinstalling, which is the point of pinning. An earlier version of this file had a second 'vendor' route that copied the built CSS into to-dos, on the belief that to-dos had no npm. It has React 18, Vite and TypeScript at its root. Its built CSS is copied out of node_modules into kanban/dist/ by its own vite build, beside board-ui.js, because the Vercel deployment has no server and no node_modules and a static path is the only one both can reach.
